nodes.name: Query: Get asset data for all usable items

data.query:
query Query($whereA: AssetWhereInput) {
  assets : asset(where: $whereA) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        maxLifetimeCycles
        currentCycles
        currentHours
        lifetimeCycles
        lifetimeHours
        maxLifetimeHours
        serialized
        barcode
        brand
        description
        externalId
        modelNumber
        serialNumber
        inServiceAt
        lastResetAt
        newAt
        purchaseAt
        customData
        integrationData
        assetMaintenanceStatusId
        assetMaintenanceStatus {
          id
          name
          disabled
          ready
          retired
          servicing
          system
          usable
          color
          externalId
          message
          customData
          integrationData
        }
        statusId
        status {
          id
          name
          active
          approved
          default
          experimental
          system
          usable
          color
          externalId
          message
          customData
          integrationData
        }
        typeId
        type {
          id
          name
          equipment
          inspection
          machinery
          system
          tooling
          usable
          color
          customData
          screenId
        }
        assetDesignId
        facilityId
        groupId
        imageId
        supplierId
        workcenterId
      }
    }
  }
}
